title: [3.0 beta4] Extremally slow TDD calculation
body:
On dialogs that use TDD stats - Statistics & Profile helper - calculating stats for TDD can take more than 30 seconds.
Propably it is caused by executing Room DB SQL query by `getTempBasalIncludingConvertedExtended` in the loop few tousand times at `TddCalculator::calculate`

comments.body: I am working on fix for that
